title: AI Lets You Start This Amazon Side Hustle in Minutes

idea.name: Shannon’s Amazon ebooks
idea.one_liner: Shannon sells ebooks he wrote through Amazon and earns ongoing royalties.

idea.name: AI-assisted low-content Amazon KDP publishing
idea.one_liner: Research demand, create and edit low-content books with AI, then sell them through Amazon KDP for royalties.
idea.customer: Readers and gift buyers searching Amazon for niche books, journals, planners, calendars and coloring books
idea.offer: Researched, customized low-content books created with AI assistance
idea.revenue_model: Amazon KDP royalties per book sold, with optional Amazon ads for titles that prove successful

key_quotes.quote: You just type in some prompts, you publish a book and you sell it.
You got to customize your templates.
There's no customer support.

claims.claim: The host describes monthly income goals ranging from $1,000 to $15,000.
claims.quote: We're just trying to make a thousand bucks a month, five, 10, 15,000 bucks a month.

claims.claim: The proposed setup assumes $20 per month for research software.
claims.quote: You pay 20 bucks a month for software, use that software to research trends, use AI another $20 a month software to generate some low content books, publish them on Amazon.

claims.claim: The proposed setup assumes another $20 per month for AI software.
claims.quote: You pay 20 bucks a month for software, use that software to research trends, use AI another $20 a month software to generate some low content books, publish them on Amazon.

claims.claim: A hypothetical book selling 10 copies per day at $3 royalties per copy would bring in about $30 per day or $1,000 per month.
claims.quote: So, let's say you make a planner or a journal that sells 10 copies a day, you make $3 in royalties per copy. That's 30 bucks a day, a thousand bucks a month.

claims.claim: Ten hypothetical winning books at the described performance would bring in $10,000 per month.
claims.quote: But if you do, then that's 10 grand a month.

claims.claim: The host says consistently publishing for 3, 6 or 12-plus months will earn income.
claims.quote: If you do this for 3, 6, 12 plus months consistently, you will earn real, real income.

acquisition_channels.details: Amazon KDP listings and keyword research intended to match books with Amazon searches.
The host suggests adding Amazon ads after identifying a winning title.

ideas.delivery: The publisher researches, creates and edits the book, then Amazon KDP prints and ships physical copies; the publisher does not handle inventory or customer support.

prices: $3 royalties per copy in the hypothetical example
